problems.problem: The declared concept specifies hard-edge horizontal sedimentary strata stacked like a core sample, but the render shows soft undulating dune-like waves. The wavy contours read as generic landscape hills rather than the crisp stratigraphic bands of the brief, weakening the geological core-sample narrative.

The flint-orange seam (the concept's burial line) sits at roughly y 965-990, almost exactly where the bottle's widest glass body begins, so the strongest color accent collides with the product silhouette edge instead of reading as an independent stratum line; the seam is also partially hidden behind the flacon, losing its survey-mark role.

The subtitle and price strings are empty, so the calm top band carries only logo, title and rule; against references (Byredo, Bleu de Chanel) the type block lacks a supporting descriptor line, leaving hierarchy thin and the lower two-thirds of the poster text-free and unbalanced.

The contact shadow verified in the base crop (soft darkening under the foot notch at y≈1339) is correct in offset, but at opacity 0.35 with blur 10 over the deep umber band it is nearly invisible, so the monument appears to hover slightly against the darkest stratum; the product's own baked high-key speculars also conflict mildly with the declared flat shadowless ink light.

changes.value: Seamless flat screen-printed matte paper poster of perfectly straight horizontal sedimentary strata bands with crisp hard edges, pale bone, sand, ochre, burnt sienna and deep umber stacked top to bottom like a drilled core sample, one thin hard-edge flint-orange seam line between the ochre and sienna bands, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients, no objects, no waves, no curves
